translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús Jerusalén-neggweburgi reyyob dogsad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala Jerusalén modanimargu, bia neggwebur-Betfagé, degi, Betania sii, yar-Olivos-nugad-abin, a-inikgusgu, Jesús na e-sapingan-warbo-barmisad,

amarga sogded: —Neggwebur-bipii anmar-asabin-siidse be namar. A-neggweburgi bemar dogdapmalale, moli-bipi-uaya-suid, dule-egi-yo-gwen-siged, be-idu atinnar-nai bemar dakdapoed. Be esikmaloed, geb degi be anse sedamaloed.
Dule-wargwen bemarga sokalir: ‘¿Ibiga bemar moli-bipi-esiknanai?’ Bemar, abin-sogoed: ‘Ar Dummad we-moli-binasoged. Ebusad-sorba bega yog gannar sedabaloye soged.’
Jesús-sapingan nadmarsun, geb degi moli-bipi-uaya-suid, igargi neg-dikarba, yawagak-naba atinnai dakdapmalad. A-moli-esiksamalad.
Dulemar-agi-gunanaid, ega sogdemalad: —¿Ibi bemar imaknanai? ¿Ibiga bemar moli-bipi-uaya-suid-esiknanai?
Jesús-sapingan-warbogwad, abin-imakdemalad, Jesús ega sogsadba. Geb degi moli-ibed ega moli-barmiarmarsunnad.
Jesús-sapingan moli-bipi-uaya-suid Jesússe senonimarsunnad. Geb degi moli-birgi na e-mormar ogichamargu, Jesús moli-birgi sigisad.
Jesús, Jerusalénse nadapgu, dule-bukidar Jesús-idu igargi e-mor ogitemalad, abala ogob-gagangiid-e-gagan gwane-gwane imakdemargu, Jesús-iduar igargi ogitemalad.
Dule-bukidar Jesús-idu-nadapmalad, degi, sorba-danimalad bela oimakdanimalad:
Degi Jesús Jerusalénse dogdapsun, geb agi Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogdesunnad. Bela a-neggi ibmar daksagu, ar neg-sedodgussoggu, Betaniase nadsunnad, e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadmala.
Jesús higuera-sapi ukabsasad
Banedgine, Betaniagi noarmargu, Jesús igarba ukur itoalid.
Dikasur higuera-sapi gagan-aramakbukwa dakargu, ese nade-gusad, dakega e-durba nika-dibeye. Sapi mosgu, san sate dakalid, unnila gaganbi aramakwichi, ar ade durba-nikuedginsulid.
Degi Jesús higuera-sapiga sogdesunnad: —Be bipisaale bar gwen durbamakosulid. Jesús-degi-sogsad e-sapingan bela itosmalad.
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-ukbukmalad-onosad

Jesús, e-sapinganmala gannar Jerusalénse nonimargu, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dognonimalad. Jesús, dulemar-a-neggi-ibmar-baknanaid, degi, ibmar-ukbukmalad, sabsur onisad. Dulemar-mani-ogwabukmalad-e-mesa binnasur bikiin meted, degi, dulemar-nuu-ukbukmalad-e-gan bar-bikiin metebalid.
Dule-wargwensaar bipisaar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ibmar-seded gwen imaksasulid.
Agi Jesús dulemar-odurdakde, sogded: —Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:

Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, escribamar, degi-Jesús-soge itosmargu, igar-amiarmarsunnad, igi-saer Jesús-oburgwemalo-dibeye. Ar ade Jesús-dobe-itomalad, ar ade bela dulemar geger Jesús-dakmalad igi dulemar-odurdakdiid.
Neg-mutikudgu, Jesús, Jerusaléngi bangudsunnad.
Higuera-sapi dingusad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala wakdar igarba nadapmargu, higuera-sapi bela e-malise-bakar dingugwichi dakarmalad.
Agi Pedro ebinsaargu, Jesúsga sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, be dake, higuera-sapi-sae-be-ukabsasad, dinguded.
Jesús ega sogded: “¿Geger be dake? Mer Bab Dummadgi be bengumala.
Napira an bemarga soged, ar doa-dule we-yarga sog-dibe: ‘Be ainir, demarse be nae,’ a-dule bensulir, e-ibmar-sogedba ega guo daker, ar a-dulega nabir ibmar guodo, yar-ainirodo.
Degisoggu, bemarga an soged, Bab Dummadse be gorsigusar, bela be-ibmar-egichiid bato begadye be binsae, ar a-ibmar bato Bab Dummad bega ukoed.
“Bab Dummadse be gotele, dule begi nosale, ies-imaked be sae, adi be-Bab-nibneggi-maid egi-be-nosad nabir bega elimogoed.
Ar bemar dule-begi-nosad ies be imaksurmalale, ar be-Bab geg be-iskusad bega elimogad.”
Judio-dummagan Jesúsga soged: ¿Doa-nuggi be ibmar imakye?

Jesús na e-sapinganmala Jerusalénse gannar nonimarbalid. Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yaba nadapgu, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, escribamar, degi, Judiomar-girmar-dummagan ese nonimalad.
Amar Jesúsga sogdemalad: —¿Doa-nuggine wede be we-ibmar-imakdii? ¿Ar doa bega gangued uksasunna, we deyob be ibmar imakegar?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —An bemarse ibmar-soggwen egismogodo. Bemar an-abin imaksale, geb an bemarga sogmogoed, doa we-gangued anga uksa we-ibmar an imakdiid.
¿Doa Juan-Bautista-barmiar be insae, Bab-Dummad-digi-ogleged-igar imakega? ¿Bab Dummad barmiali, igi, dulemar barmiali? Anga be sogmalana.
Degi, Judio-dummagan muchub-muchub na sogdemalad: “Bab Dummad barmiarye anmar sogmalale, anmarga sogdagoed: ‘Degite ¿ibiga bemar Juan-Bautista-bengusmarsunna?’
Dulemar barmiarye anmar sogbalile, dulemar sunna sabsur anmar-imakmaloed.” Degisoggu, degi-soged dobe itomarbalid, ar ade bela sogmalad, Juan, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-sunnadye.
Degisoggu, Judio-dummagan Jesús-abin-sogdemarsunnad: —Anmar wichurmalad, doa Juan-Bautista-barmiali. Degi Jesús, abin-imakdemosunnad: —An bemarga sogosurmarmodo, wede doa-nuggi we-ibmar an imakdii.
